notes: Read the complete Israeli-Palestinian policy unit, full Israel-security context, all six candidates and the review. Restored President Obama as the speaker making Israel's security a necessary condition for lasting peace. Resolved the Palestinian partner as a partner in Israeli-Palestinian peace. Also restored the explicit connection from the commitment to Israel's security to seeking peace and the ongoing encouragement of every party to pursue peace resolutely.

claims.claim_text: President Obama and the Democratic Party seek Israeli-Palestinian peace precisely because of their commitment to Israel's security.
President Obama stated that lasting peace is impossible unless Israel's security concerns are met.
President Obama and the Democratic Party would continue encouraging every party to pursue peace resolutely.
Any Palestinian partner in an Israeli-Palestinian peace agreement must recognize Israel's right to exist, reject violence and comply with existing agreements.
